svg.title: Recompete Pricing Funnel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-recompete-pricing-funnel; chapter number: 6; title: Recompete Pricing Funnel; subtitle: Sizing the pipeline, then recovering the real incumbent number from FPDS; caption: Neil McDonnell sizes recompete pipeline at $25-100M of opportunities for every $5M of revenue targeted. Fox Wade recovered $1,686,566.88 over three years from modification 0 of a DHS NAICS 541611 incumbent, where the latest action alone showed 348k.; assumptions note: Stages 1-3 restate McDonnell's pipeline rule and stages 4-5 restate one Fox Wade recompete, so the values are not a single continuous conversion path. Kizzy Parks assumed an Army award was at least $250K and it came in around $35K, so the POC is asked for incumbent, contract number and value every time.; note: Sources - Neil McDonnell (17foq325L5w), Fox Wade (Z2ZeI5rayvk), Kizzy Parks (L0SM3XAM3IE), FedAccess (GrYP5KyxBho).; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Pipeline Ceiling; value: 100000000; display: $100M; conversion: Top of the $25-100M band per $5M targeted; detail: McDonnell pulls recompetes from FPDS and saves each search by URL, because the query lives in the URL.; label: Pipeline Floor; value: 25000000; display: $25M; conversion: Bottom of the band per $5M targeted; detail: McDonnell's floor, with 2027 revenue to be won in 2026.; label: Revenue Target; value: 5000000; display: $5M; conversion: Revenue the pipeline must convert into; detail: The revenue unit McDonnell's pipeline multiple is anchored to.; label: Incumbent Base Award Recovered; value: 1686566.88; display: $1,686,566.88; conversion: Modification 0 over three years; detail: Fox Wade sorted FPDS by date signed and pulled modification 0 of the DHS incumbent, then pulled the old solicitation because scope can grow from 2 people to 10 (FedAccess).; label: Latest-Action Trap; value: 348000; display: $348K; conversion: Latest action alone; detail: The number a pricer sees by skipping modification 0, which Fox Wade warns distorts the recompete price.

circle.title: label: Pipeline Ceiling; value: 100000000; display: $100M; conversion: Top of the $25-100M band per $5M targeted; detail: McDonnell pulls recompetes from FPDS and saves each search by URL, because the query lives in the URL.
label: Pipeline Floor; value: 25000000; display: $25M; conversion: Bottom of the band per $5M targeted; detail: McDonnell's floor, with 2027 revenue to be won in 2026.
label: Revenue Target; value: 5000000; display: $5M; conversion: Revenue the pipeline must convert into; detail: The revenue unit McDonnell's pipeline multiple is anchored to.

label: Incumbent Base Award Recovered; value: 1686566.88; display: $1,686,566.88; conversion: Modification 0 over three years; detail: Fox Wade sorted FPDS by date signed and pulled modification 0 of the DHS incumbent, then pulled the old solicitation because scope can grow from 2 people to 10 (FedAccess).

label: Latest-Action Trap; value: 348000; display: $348K; conversion: Latest action alone; detail: The number a pricer sees by skipping modification 0, which Fox Wade warns distorts the recompete price.

text.title: Assumptions: Stages 1-3 restate McDonnell's pipeline rule and stages 4-5 restate one Fox Wade recompete, so the values are not a single continuous conversion path. Kizzy Parks assumed an Army award was at least $250K and it came in around $35K, so the POC is asked for incumbent, contract number and value every time.
